geometry_stats.fitted_on: all coordinate training valid nodes only
geometry_stats.statistics_input: cached float32 geometry converted to float64
geometry_stats.neighbor_policy: exclude self/padding; include all kth-distance ties; use all when fewer than k

lr.rule: successful-update warmup then cosine, independent of VAL

checkpoint_rule: strict minimum full VAL macro_vs_sbs_pct with common new81000 TRAIN-fitted SBS; first wins ties
inference_rule: eval mode, fixed physical-node0 TSP slot3 role, original R77 score MLP/pair differences/maximin; stable ascending-global-solver-ID tie break
source_plan: common seed2 full18 natural stream; exact1024 rows, shuffled tails carried across cycles
gradients: micro rows / global1024; one clip/step; AMP overflow replays same batch and RNG
train_eval: full TRAIN every5 VAL points plus the selected best if absent
test: one full TEST after unique VAL-best lock; saved predictions reusable
test_rnd_disclosure: TEST informed earlier R&D; preserved old holdouts plus previously unused input-stratified extensions
nss_reference: reuse exact4500 R84 predictions from locked R79 weights; no NSS inference/retraining

record.tasks: all18 complete legal pools; no method-pair expert or class quota
record.initialization: identical prepared fresh seed2 R77 parameters and TRAIN-only geometry statistics; never a trained selector checkpoint
record.model: original R77 dual-stream model, shared score MLP, utility differences and maximin; fixed R88B TSP physical-node0 input role

both_arms.objective: 0.35 CE + 0.35 original comparison + 0.02 original relative-gap risk + original R-Drop ramp to0.35
both_arms.comparison_focus: original Top3 of the average of the two detached MAXIMIN outputs; not raw-utility averaged Top3
both_arms.inference: original maximin ranking and argmax; stable global-solver-ID tie break
both_arms.cost_labels: unchanged native FP64 labels and existing comparison/regret targets, supervision only

record.optimizer: actual AdamW lr1e-4 weight_decay1e-4; original successful-update warmup then cosine to1e-6
record.microbatch_semantics: ordinary sample-weighted accumulation; every objective term is instance-separable, no cross-instance loss or queue
record.batch_and_task_order: same deterministic natural full18 R84 streams; each successful update consumes1024 rows including stream wrap
record.checkpoint_selection: strict minimum full18 VAL macro_vs_sbs_pct with TRAIN-fitted SBS; retain first exact tie
record.formal_evaluation: lock one checkpoint and original inference rule using VAL only, then complete same-version TEST and LIB
record.empirical_screen: each arm increases VAL macro Top1 while VAL macro mean_cost and actual regret do not increase versus same-data R84A and old-loss same-role R88B; also compare B against A
record.mechanism_metrics: fixed R84 36-group target recall, rescues, lost winners, false picks and net paired cost; fewer zero-selection groups alone is not success

historical_references.R84A: same data original input/loss; already completed, not retrained
historical_references.R88B: same data and role input, old probability links; historical control, not a fresh simultaneous old-loss arm
historical_references.R64_R65_R75: already used raw-utility CE in different cohorts and CE-plus-KL recipes without current comparison/risk; not evidence that raw CE is new or will succeed here

record.rationale: conditional test of training probability-link geometry; not an expressivity defect, confirmed plateau cause, or guarantee that raw CE improves Top1
record.execution: two released existing allocation1465 gpu03 3090s after R88 full delivery rc0; R89 on two4090s untouched
record.cache: reuse existing frozen R84 cache and TRAIN-only prepared artifacts; no data copy, preprocessing, relabeling or solver run
record.nss: reuse locked R84 same4500 TEST and LIB NSS predictions; no NSS retraining

objective.comparison: original pair margins and comparison loss; unchanged averaged-maximin Top3 focus

historical_reference.evidence: main historical reference; not a newly matched original-loss control

same_role_reference.evidence: historical same-role old-loss reference; not a newly matched original-loss control

evidence_boundary: A/B controls probability links only; historical R88B/R84A are not newly matched original-loss controls
